name: quillon-wallet-mcp
description: Quillon Wallet, Mining, DEX, Agent-Panel & QSHARE MCP server — every signed tool just works against production via the X-Wallet-Auth seed-derived signing path (file-first then env). v2.3.0 adds get_token_balance + tx_status + arb_scan (triangular arb across all DEX pools) + deploy_token, fixes the 10^16 decimal-display bug in dex_get_quote/dex_swap, and supports commemorative drops (GROK + future).
